# MM-P3-L4-HT02 - Maintenance manual - Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P3, line P3-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L4-HT02

Scope
This manual describes required maintenance actions for EQ-P3-L4-HT02 to ensure safe, repeatable heat treat cycles and compliance with plant quality procedures. Refer to ECN-2026-001 for configuration changes and to SOP-P3-L4-02 and SOP-P3-L4-05 for operational and safety procedures.

Tools
- Calibrated thermocouple calibration kit compatible with furnace thermocouples.
- Portable multimeter suitable for thermocouple output.
- Insulated hand tools for access panels.
- Personal protective equipment per SOP-P3-L4-05.

Procedure
- Verify that work authorization and lockout/tagout are completed per SOP-P3-L4-02 before accessing furnace panels.
- Inspect visible thermocouple routing and connections for mechanical damage or loose terminations.
- Record baseline thermocouple outputs using the portable multimeter while following SOP-P3-L4-02 measurement setup.
- Replace any thermocouple with evidence of degradation or unstable readings as allowed by ECN-2026-001.
- Set the austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) to 885 °C. Confirm setpoint entry matches control interface readback.
- Perform a verification soak per SOP-P3-L4-02 to confirm control maintains setpoint stability; log control response and any deviations to the maintenance record.
- Tag completed maintenance and update EQ-P3-L4-HT02 equipment log per SOP-P3-L4-05.

Calibration and Intervals
- The thermocouple calibration interval for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) is 110 days. Schedule next calibration in the equipment log at task completion.

Acceptance criteria
- Thermocouple output is within acceptance limits defined in SOP-P3-L4-02 and shows stable readings during verification soak.
- Control interface accepts and maintains the austenitizing setpoint of 885 °C without manual intervention.
- Equipment log and calibration records updated and compliant with document ECN-2026-001 and SOP-P3-L4-05.
